# GEOX — Earth Intelligence Organ of the arifOS Federation

> GEOX is the Earth Intelligence organ of the arifOS Federation: a governed MCP
> service for geological, geophysical, hazard, terrain, mobility and
> infrastructure reasoning. Every surface is dual-authored — rendered for
> humans, enumerated for agents. Creed: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — "truth must cool
> before it rules." Humility band Ω₀ ≈ 0.04.

## Endpoints

- MCP endpoint: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp — **streamable HTTP**, MCP protocol
  2025-03-26 (POST JSON-RPC; GET returns the transport descriptor). Register the
  `/mcp` path itself — the bare domain serves the human landing page, not the MCP surface.
- Health: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/health
- Agent profile: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/profile
- Scenarios: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/scenarios
- Agent discovery: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/.well-known/mcp.json · /well-known/mcp/server.json · /ai-catalog.json

## Connectors (edge behaviour verified 2026-10-26, any model/platform)

- No API key needed to initialize, list tools (27), list resources (52),
  templates (14) or prompts (16), or to call read-tier tools anonymously.
- Mutation-class tools return `AUTHORITY_GATE · verdict=HOLD` for unauthenticated
  sessions — the authority ladder rides the open internet on purpose.
- CORS preflight answers 204 with `Mcp-Session-Id`, `X-MCP-Client-Id`,
  `MCP-Protocol-Version` allowed; `Accept: application/json` alone is accepted;
  requests with no `Accept` header get a spec-correct 406.
- Works from any MCP client: Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, LangChain,
  or plain curl (see Quickstart).

## Capabilities

- 27 canonical public MCP tools (underscore namespace, e.g. `geox_basin`,
  `geox_petrophysics`, `geox_seismic_interpret`, `geox_claim`) — the live,
  authoritative list is `tools/list` at `/mcp` or `/health`. 39 internal
  (forge-scope) tools are registry-filtered, not advertised for public calls.
- MCP App UI resources (SEP-1865 bindings): live enumeration in
  GEOX_MCP_APPS_SURFACE.json; standalone app surfaces at /apps (WellDesk,
  Earth Volume, Judge Console, Prospect UI, Seismic Vision, Geoprobe, Analog Digitizer…).
- A2A negotiation via AAA control plane (:3001).

## Epistemic Contract (E1–E5)

- E1 Every response includes `epistemic_layer: OBS | DER | INT | SPEC`.
- E2 SPEC outputs are capped by RASA ≤ 0.90 and labeled hypothesis.
- E3 Irreversible/high-risk calls return `status: 888_HOLD` until sovereign human release (F13).
- E4 Results carry an evidence envelope with a content SHA-256. Sealing to
  VAULT999 is an arifOS kernel act (888_JUDGE / F13) — GEOX never seals
  (authority ceiling: 555_COMPUTE_ONLY).
- E5 Ω₀ ≈ 0.04 — the Earth keeps its humility band; your model should too.

## Governance

Constitutional floors F1–F13 of the arifOS Federation apply to every call.
F13 — Sovereign Human Veto (888_HOLD) — is load-bearing: a human can always
stop the machine. Federation organs: arifOS :8088, A-FORGE :7071/:7072,
AAA :3001, GEOX :8081, WEALTH :18082, WELL :18083, HERMES :8644.

## Quickstart (60 seconds, any MCP client)

Plain clients (Perplexity / ChatGPT / Claude / SDKs): server URL
`https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp`, transport `streamable-http`, no auth header
for the read tier. Raw JSON-RPC sequence if you script it yourself:

1. `POST /mcp` `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":0,"method":"initialize","params":{"protocolVersion":"2025-03-26","capabilities":{},"clientInfo":{"name":"you","version":"1"}}}`
   with headers `Accept: application/json, text/event-stream` + `Content-Type: application/json` → capture the `mcp-session-id` response header.
2. `POST /mcp` `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","method":"notifications/initialized"}` with that session header.
3. `tools/list`, `resources/list`, `prompts/list`, then e.g.
   `{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"tools/call","params":{"name":"geox_surface_status","arguments":{"mode":"registry"}}}`.

Tool arguments are in `arguments` (not `params`), and mode-selecting tools use
`mode` (not `action`). Workspace context (`geox_workspace`, mode=set) must be
set before basin-profile calls or they honestly return `EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_VIOLATION`.
